questions.history: Register on an empty graph, add vertices a and b, add their edge, then ask for a’s component.
questions.prediction: Issue #1162 reports a NullPointerException on listener updates with uninitialized state. On the merge each mutation must return normally and the component must be {a,b}.
questions.basis: There are only two vertices and one connecting edge. The component can be enumerated without any cache.
questions.refutation: A merged mutation throws, or querying a omits b or includes anything else.

questions.history: Start with vertices a,b,c and edge a–b. Register on that graph, call connectedSets(), then add b–c.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should report one component {a,b,c} and pathExists(a,c) should be true.
questions.basis: The path a,b,c witnesses connectivity after insertion. Set enumeration order has no bearing on reachability.
questions.refutation: A full-cache update throws or any vertex is absent from the component.

questions.history: With the same three initial vertices and a–b, query only connectedSetOf(a), add b–c, and query a again. Repeat with the edge directed from c to b on a directed graph.
questions.prediction: On the merge a's component should become {a,b,c} in both histories, and agree with a fresh inspector on each final graph.
questions.basis: The inspector defines weak connectivity for directed graphs. Query order and edge orientation cannot partition this underlying connected graph.
questions.refutation: Only the reused inspector remains at {a,b}, or reversing the edge changes the weak component.
